BiblicalUsage: Ken is the Aramaic word for so, thus. Ezra 6:2 says a roll was found, and therein was a record thus written, and Daniel 2:24 has Daniel saying thus unto Arioch, destroy not the wise men of Babylon.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe thus is the word of the record: what is written stands, and Daniel spoke by it to save lives.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
